                                EXHIBIT AND WITNESS LIST OF
                           OKLAHOMA INDUSTRIAL ENERGY CONSUMERS

                 Oklahoma Industrial Energy Consumers (“OIEC”) designates Mark E. Garrett as its expert

        witness and the following as exhibits that could be used by OIEC during the hearing on the merits

        in this case:

                1.     All testimony, and all source documents, exhibits and schedules attached or
        referenced in all such testimony, filed by any witness on behalf of OIEC, including any errata,
        amendments or supplements thereto.

                2.     All testimony, and all source documents, exhibits and schedules attached or
        referenced in all such testimony, filed by any witness on behalf of the Applicant, the Public Utility
        Division of the Oklahoma Corporation Commission (PUD), the Attorney General or any
        intervenor, including any errata, amendments or supplements thereto.

                3.    All data requests and all interrogatories propounded by OIEC, the Applicant, PUD,
        the Attorney General or any intervener in this proceeding and all responses thereto.

                4.     All workpapers of witnesses for OIEC, Applicant, PUD, Attorney General or any
        other intervener in this proceeding.

                 5.    Any and all public filings and submissions heretofore made by the Applicant, or its
        affiliates with the Commission Court Clerk, the Commission Staff or the Federal Energy
        Regulatory Commission.

                 6.    Publicly disclosed information relating to any issues raised in this proceeding,
        including, but not limited to, public information relating to Applicant, its parent company or its
        affiliates.
 CASE PUD 2026-000031 ENTRY NO. 115 FILED IN OCC COURT CLERK'S OFFICE ON 08/31/2026 - PAGE 2 OF 3




                 7.     Exhibits necessary or helpful in supporting any oral surrebuttal testimony offered
        in this case by OIEC.

                8.     Exhibits necessary or helpful in impeaching or cross-examining any oral surrebuttal
        or sur-surrebuttal testimony allowed in this case by other parties.

               9.      All Commission rules, orders and Oklahoma statutes.

        OIEC reserves the right to supplement this Exhibit List as circumstances require.
